name: AveryGPT
description:
AveryGPT connects Claude to live commercial real estate data so you can research properties, find lenders, and manage finance deals without leaving your conversation.

Key features:

Property search — Look up listings, sales comps, and finance/mortgage comps by radius or state and property type. Get full property details including ownership, sale history, and tax assessment.
Lender match — Search lenders by location, state, loan profile, or name. Drill into bank and banker profiles with contact details and lending parameters.
Deal management — View and create finance deals, read uploaded deal documents, and manage your lender quote list.

Lender search, bank details, and quote management require a paid AveryGPT membership. Property lookups, deal management, and document reading are available on free accounts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AveryGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AveryGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.averygpt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AveryGPT MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AveryGPT lists 23 MCP tools, including create_finance_deal, geocode_address, get_bank_details, get_banker_details, get_basic_property_info_by_address, get_finance_deal_details, get_property_details, list_finance_deal_documents, list_finance_deal_quotes, list_finance_deals, read_finance_deal_document, and search_lender_by_name.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AveryGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AveryGPT in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AveryGPT requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AveryGPT is developed by AveryGPT LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
